title: Which loading dimensions should I use when choosing a rack for a copper-wire-coil annealing furnace?
summary: A Suneng copper-wire coil annealing proposal lists both a 2000 × 2000 × 1900 mm chamber and effective working dimensions of Ø1710 × 1600 mm. Racks and coils must be checked against the permitted loading zone, rather than assuming all of the square chamber is available to the workpieces.
